dog.description_text: Meet Cosmo — New Arrival! Cosmo just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FCosmo%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQp4cwEplbAmSa1ijmn6Z0meEgUDn%2DX6BMo%5FFvX9NbvlEC3Ksw Her foster says "From the very first moments Cosmo was with us she was never shy or hiding. She loves to be with people and interact with everyone. She loves getting pets, and would happily be petted all day if she could! She’s also a lap cat! She loves sleeping on my lap every time I work at my desk or relaxing on the couch. She loves playing and has so much energy! One of her favorite things is jumping to catch her toys." She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
